posts.cooked:
I’m getting an alert from macOS Tahoe about Battle.net

Support Ending for Intel-based Apps

This version of “Battle.net” will not open in a future release of macOS.

I didn’t realize this was still Intel, since WoW itself is compiled for Apple SIlicon. I figured the easy thing to compile for ARM would’ve been done…. but alas…. it has not.

I see nothing on the forums so far about this, so figured I’d be the first. When can we get an ARM version of Battle.net, Agent, etc? And I hope the answer isn’t just before (or, let’s be real, after) the macOS comes out that deprecates this.

posts.name: Barlexis
posts.cooked:
Blizzard customer support handles stuff like billing, account management, etc. They cannot and will not provide technical support. There is no technical support. So they refer you to this forum so you can get a possible answer from other users.

And the answer is… we don’t know what Blizzard’s plans are. The Mac dropping support for Intel software is still over a year away, and even then, only if you upgrade to MacOS 28. So for now, there isn’t a problem. You can ignore the pop up warning.

Yes, it’s frustrating that we are being left hanging because of an obsolete and crummy app launcher. But I find it hard to believe Blizz will throw away significant chunk of its player base just because it can’t update or replace its lousy app launcher.

That said, I’m not buying or preordering the next expansion if this still hasn’t been resolved by then.

“Must”? There’s no must. It’s entirely possible that Microsoft is writing a brand new launcher, one that would encompass all of Microsoft gaming rather than just Blizzard & Activision games, and that there won’t be a Mac version because MS doesn’t care about gaming on the Mac. They’ve just been coasting, willing to keep milking Mac users for WOW subscriptions as long as it was convenient, and when Rosetta goes away it won’t be convenient anymore so bye-bye Mac support.

Not saying that will happen, but it wouldn’t surprise me at all. Remember, the launcher was never a Warcraft thing, it was always a Blizzard/Activision thing and so now it’s a Microsoft thing.

People overreact to this a bit. intel support is only being removed from macOS 28 when it ships late next year. macOS 27 and 26 are only giving early notice.

I’m sure blizzard will make bnet universal eventually, it’ll just be at last minute like always.
